description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare that Excise Duty on Motor Cars and Other Motor Vehicles Shall be Payable w. e. f. 30.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty rates on specific goods (motor vehicles) through a statutory order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It constitutes a regulatory change to existing legislation rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the legal/regulatory function of the notice.
